en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to familiarize students with sources of reproductive material, collection, processing, quality assessment, storage and pre-sowing treatment of seeds, the main legislative aspects of nursery production and the management of nursery operations differentiated according to their size.
